scope.basis: Automated candidate topic screening of manifest-pinned accepted preview cards; grouped per section and topic.
scope.completeness: Not an exhaustive visual needs audit. Pattern matches can be false positives and omit image-only content or synonyms. Review each candidate against the source, course context and existing assets; no factual clearance is implied.

sources.export_policy: only ledger tasks with status accepted in learner stages are copied; everything else stays synthetic
sources.handbook_source: See each card source_ref; URLs, pages and printed pages are copied from the accepted export and are not independently verified.
sources.page_number_note: source_ref.pdf_page is the physical PDF page where present; printed_page is the export value. Missing source details remain null or absent.

asset_policy.signs: Use correctly sourced, accurate artwork; verify current authority, state applicability and reuse rights. Do not invent sign appearances.
asset_policy.diagrams: Verify each depicted scenario and rule against official state evidence; do not infer unstated behavior.
asset_policy.accessibility: Provide meaningful alternative text; do not rely on color alone.
asset_policy.cross_state: Recheck state applicability and conditions before reusing a visual.

source_cards.back: In a skid, stay off the brake until speed bleeds down, steer toward your target, unwind the wheel as the car straightens to block a swing the other way, and keep correcting left and right until it tracks true.

source_cards.back: Burn headlights to be seen, flash highs to announce, always pair wipers with lights by law, light early dusk, shun parking lamps rolling, and glow driving from low suns.

source_cards.front: How should you answer an oncoming driver whose high beams stay on?
source_cards.back: Answer stuck high beams with quick flashes, then hug the right edge if glare persists, and never duel brights since mutual blindness follows.

source_cards.front: Which beam fits empty dark, which fits crowds and fog, and how do you meet stubborn highs?
source_cards.back: Empty dark calls high beams, crowds and fog call lows, and stubborn opposing highs earn quick flashes then right edge eyes, never revenge glare.

source_cards.front: How far do high beams reach, and what do soupy storms and blind hills demand?
source_cards.back: High beams reach four hundred feet capping speed near fifty, soupy storms shrink sight to two hundred feet ordering full pull offs, and blind hills and bends demand stop ready pacing.
